decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit builds directly on the firm's dental equipment know-how and has had its own page for two years, so the firm can interpret results and refine it with its in-house R&D.

An orthopedic shoe last lies far from the firm's dental and hearing knowledge base, which limits its ability to assimilate market feedback, so despite the dedicated page it is likely to be withdrawn in favour of core digital-production projects.

The post-curing unit complements the firm's digital 3D-printing workflows for dental and hearing applications, so related knowledge and in-house R&D support keeping and improving it despite only modest website presence.
